summary: Choose a finite set T of places with ideles = principal · T-units, generators s of the T-units and ℓ'^N-th roots y_u of them. Chebotarev gives P of prime norm and a Frobenius σ fixing the ℓ'^N-th roots of unity and the y_u, near z. Then q_P ≡ 1 mod ℓ'^N, and the residue map at P followed by 𝔽_P^× → ℤ/ℓ'^N extends from the T-unit ideles to an idele class character θ; h = θ(x/x̄)∘Art⁻¹ by class field theory sends the tame generator to the generator 1 = ofAdd 1 of ℤ/ℓ'^N; φ = σγ^{a} with h(φ) = 0. (h and f take values in Multiplicative (ZMod (ℓ'^N)), the multiplicative copy of ℤ/ℓ'^N: where a step writes f(t) = 1, f(u_P) = 1 or h(φ) = 1, it means the identity, the additive 0; h(γ) = ofAdd 1 is the additive 1.)
